Episode 260. Patriarch Succession Ceremony (3)
The Black Sea was no longer a dark land like in the previous world.

The entire region had transformed into a state like Morganiel's territory. There were bright yellow trees that grew ten steps high, and insects of unknown names and blue and red flowers drenched the whole land.
If there was a forest that had first bloomed in the world, it would have looked just like this. There was no trace of human touch anywhere, and the winding paths and rivers were endlessly intricate.

But Jin moved through the Black Sea as comfortably as if he were strolling through his own home. The land moved as if to welcome him, giving way, and the trees danced, creating a cool breeze on every path Jin walked.
Chiron was sitting in its deepest part.
"You're here."
"Yes, Father."
"Sit."
A bottle of wine and two glasses were placed between the father and son who sat facing each other. Chiron slowly filled the glasses.
Gurgle, gurgle...
A moment later, the glasses clinked, and the father and son downed the wine in one gulp.
"It tastes good. Do you know what this wine is?"
"I'm not sure. It's the first time I've had it, but it's very sweet and fragrant to my taste as well."
"Fate Liquor. The Wine of Fate."
"The Wine of Fate, you say...?"
"It's the wine your mother used to brew for me to drink with her when we were young."
Jin's eyes wavered.
"There was none left, so I tried to imitate it and brewed it myself. Fortunately, it tastes similar."
"Mother..."
For a long while, Jin looked down at the sky reflected in his wine glass, unable to continue.
To Jin, Rosa was no longer a mother. The Evil God. An enemy who had tried to drive the world to ruin before Kelliark.
But Jin refilled his empty glass and opened his mouth again.
"What kind of person was Mother to you, Father?"
"She was a beautiful person. A person with a cute side, who would brew wine saying it was our fate and even name it the Wine of Fate."
Jin had seen that side of Rosa too.
The last remaining humanity of Rosa Runcandel, separated from the Evil God. In the battle against the Evil God, Jin had heard her story.
"Mother in her younger days said she liked you because you were handsome, Father."
Honestly, the look of that person as she said those words was not so hateful, at least for that moment.
She wasn't loathsome and disgusting like a traitor to the family, like the Evil God. That was why even then, Jin had spoken of her and the Evil God as separate entities.
"I should have been the one to cut down Rosa, not you. This... was hard to say."
I'm sorry.
At Chiron's unspoken words, Jin emptied his glass.
"Is that all you're sorry for?"
"No. There are so many that it's hard to say them one by one."
For the first time, Jin did not feel the aura of the great Sword God from the drinking Chiron.
He could only see the form of an ordinary human, regretting and suffering from his past. Who had not been a good husband, not a good brother, and not a good father.
He could see the dark and bitter face of a man. But his eyes were not avoiding Jin's gaze.
For a long while, the father and son emptied their glasses without a word. Pouring a new Wine of Fate, Jin let out a chuckle.
"This wine, I think I'll brew and drink it in the future as well."
"It's an easy wine to brew."
"That's a relief."
"Youngest."
"Yes."
"When did you become so strong? How did you become so strong that I no longer have anything to teach you, nothing to leave you?"
"From what I feel, your life was not easy, Father."
"Everyone's life in the world is like that."

"Not for those who live a life only for themselves. The me from before my regression would be a prime example. At that time, I was so busy looking into my own pain and desires that I couldn't even find Gilly again after my situation improved. I was trash."
"That too is something I am sorry to you for."

"But you, Father, never lived a life for yourself for even a moment. You were shouldering the world, weren't you? From the Five Kings of the Black Sea, so that this world would not fall from your shoulders. So I do not hate or resent you, Father."
"You're too kind."
"It's because I've become strong enough to be so now, just as you said, Father."
Grin. The father and son smiled, showing their teeth.
"Did you say your goodbyes to everyone well?"
Farewell.
His siblings and comrades thought Jin didn't know, but he did.
Chiron was leaving now. Forever, to a place whose whereabouts could not be known while one was alive.
"It was a time when I felt anew that there are things that can't help but be disappointing, no matter how hard you try."
When Elona and Helluram had restored the world, there was one problem they ultimately couldn't eliminate. Morganiel. The largest piece of the Five Kings of the Black Sea that had seeped into Chiron.
Morganiel had already been assimilated into his inner self when Chiron was young. It was the reason why Chiron had suffered from demonization for so long.
-From what I've faced so far, that being was not just a fragment of the Source Stone.
-Not a fragment of the Source Stone... does that mean Morganiel existed before the Source Stone was destroyed?

-Yes. Glyec, Kial, S... Nirgand. I thought the kings of the Black Sea were all born at the same time, but Morganiel was not. Morganiel is a kind of great resentment. It had wandered the world for a long time and had settled in the Source Stone the moment it was born.
-Are you saying it existed from the beginning, like the Sun God?
-I don't know that much, Vahn. But since Morganiel was guarding the sanctuary Solderet had left behind, it must have had some connection to him. That's why it opened the path for us now.

"The original of the Origin Stone, the Source Stone. Morganiel was born the moment that Source Stone was created. To be precise, it would be more correct to say that the resentment of the world that had existed before then had gained a physical form. The resentments that had flowed on the light..."
The resentment of the world.
In other words, the world could not understand those who hated and denied each other without any particular reason.
The moment a power that could completely erase this land without a trace, that could manipulate even what had already passed, first appeared, the world agonized.
Should I annihilate them, or watch over them? It was the same dilemma that the Sun God Kinzelo had faced.
Then, when Chiron finally reached him with his people, the world, Morganiel, had made a decision. That he had to give Chiron a little more time, that he had to watch over him.
Morganiel was an error created from the mistakes of the previous world.

"The reason why Lady Elona couldn't remain in this world, even while cherishing your friend so much, is the same as mine. For me and Morganiel to be separated again and for only me to remain in this world as I am is in the realm of manipulation. Still, to be allowed this time to say a final goodbye to everyone is an undeserved blessing."
For a year after the Demon God War had ended, Chiron had diligently met people.
Not as the great Sword God, but as someone's father, someone's friend, he had spent ordinary and precious days.
He had danced with Luna in a tavern, gone to see the stars with Luntia, visited Diphus's grave with Mary, picked green roses with Yona, and trained with the Tona brothers.

He had sung with Vallas, watched a play with Zed, drunk jewel wine with Vahn, ridden a Mort with Talaris, written a letter with Kashimir, watched the fools of the former Kinzelo with Orgal, and visited the mausoleum with his knights.
And now, he was having a drink with Jin, just the two of them.
Until today, he had never done so.
"I didn't have the confidence. To have a drink with you, youngest, just the two of us."
"Was that also because you were sorry?"
A single tear flowed from Chiron's eye. The tear was quickly buried in a wrinkle and disappeared.
"Then the reason you chose me as your last drinking partner is because I'm that strong. So you felt you could shamelessly say you're sorry and rely on me, right?"
"That's right. That's why I said my goodbyes to everyone else first and came to find you only now."
"It's a point where I regret saying on the succession day that I was secretly hoping you would pour me a drink, Father."
"It sounded like you were telling me to leave quickly."
Hehehe. The father and son looked at each other and laughed.

"In any case, you chose well. I am the strongest person in the world, am I not? My swordsmanship is just a little inferior to yours and Brother Battle God's. My sisters all have a delicate side, and my brothers... needless to say. Those guys, did they cry a lot?"
"They all cried so much it was embarrassing. I broke a sweat trying to hug them as if I were a good father. It wasn't just your siblings who cried. You, have you ever seen Vahn cry?"
"Wow... Brother Battle God?"

"She tried to pretend she wasn't crying until the very end. Her acting was so pathetic that I pretended to be deceived, but it was an endlessly awkward time for both of us. My great-grandfather even threw a punch at me, crying, asking if I had to go before him. Talaris, she questioned why I kept going first, just like Ron."
But none of them showed it in front of Jin. Except for Gilly, who couldn't hold back while showing him the note last night, everyone had acted as if nothing was wrong.
Jin had also continued to pretend he didn't know.
As the strongest person.
"Then, this must be the first time you've cried, Father."
"What are you talking about?"
"Come on, didn't you say it was endlessly awkward because of Sister Vahn?"
"Hahaha... yes. Since I was born and developed a sense of self, this is the first time tears have come. What should I say..."
It's bittersweet.
The father and son downed the last of the wine.
And as if by promise, they stood up from their seats at the same time and slowly drew their swords.
"I will consider it a great honor that the last person this Chiron Runcandel crosses swords with is you."
"I will consider it so as well."
Every time Barisada and Bradamante clashed, a heavy and clear sound echoed.
It is unknown how long they crossed swords. The father and son's swords never once directly grazed each other's flesh.
Just as people exchange stories about their lives, they would just leave a sound and a trajectory near each other once in a while.
Chiron's body was becoming more and more transparent. Then, when it seemed he could no longer remain in the world, Chiron planted Barisada in the ground.
Then, the unfamiliar blues, the unfamiliar colors that had been covering the Black Sea, flashed into light for a moment.
Jin, opening his eyes again, sheathed his sword and looked down at Barisada. The sword now stood tall and alone, just as the life of his just-departed father had been.
"...Goodbye, Father."
Only then could Jin cry.
The hilt of Barisada, which he had knelt and grabbed with both hands, was warm.
